# nexCommerce — Intelligent Personal Style & Luxury Modern Wardrobe

> nexCommerce is an editorial e-commerce platform blending curated luxury apparel, architectural tailoring, minimalist essentials, and personal styling intelligence.

## Core Philosophy & Collections
- **Form in Motion (Autumn / Winter 2026):** Architectural cashmere knitwear, structured Italian wool tailoring, vegetable-tanned leather goods, and high-fidelity studio acoustics.
- **Craftsmanship Guarantee:** 100% genuine, ethically sourced items, 14-day complimentary returns, and free express worldwide shipping on orders exceeding €150.00.

## Primary Product Categories
- **Apparel & Knitwear:** Architectural cashmere sweaters, tailored trousers, relaxed wool coats.
- **Tailoring:** Italian structured blazers, minimal suiting, modern silhouettes.
- **Footwear:** Italian leather sneakers, Chelsea boots, minimal loafers.
- **Accessories & Audio:** Quilted leather structured totes, vegetable-tanned bags, studio headphones.

## Key Storefront Destinations
- **Homepage:** [nexCommerce Storefront](http://localhost:3000/)
- **Curated Category Grid:** [Browse Collections](http://localhost:3000/category)
- **Natural Language Discovery:** [Aesthetic Search & Discovery](http://localhost:3000/discovery)
- **Size & Measurement Guide:** [Size Guide](http://localhost:3000/size-guide)
- **Customer Care & Support:** [Help & Client Relations](http://localhost:3000/help)
- **About & Brand Provenance:** [About nexCommerce](http://localhost:3000/about)

## Dynamic Sitemaps & Technical Directives
- **XML Sitemap:** [sitemap.xml](http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml)
- **Robots Policy:** [robots.txt](http://localhost:3000/robots.txt)
